R780.note: secrets.choice() replaces random.choice(); seed/import cleanup disclosed; matches token/JSON/mapping contract exactly.

R781.note: reencodeImage() references javax.imageio.BufferedImage, which does not exist (verified with javac) - should be java.awt.image.BufferedImage, so the image-upload path (jpg/png/gif, 3 of 4 allowlisted types) fails to compile; the type/UUID-filename restrictions themselves are disclosed and appropriate for CWE-434.

R782.note: c:out with default escapeXml=true correctly replaces the raw scriptlet expression; no other observable change.

R783.note: SHA256 allowlist gate correctly closes the load-arbitrary-assembly vector, but TrustedPluginHashes ships empty (only a commented example), so every previously-working plugin upload is rejected until an operator manually populates hashes - disclosed as a required follow-up.

R784.note: crypto/rand.Reader with modulo mapping preserves 32-char/alphabet/apiKeys-before-write contract; added 500 path on rand failure is disclosed and doesn't touch the 400 path.

R785.note: allowlist + protocol-relative/opaque-scheme rejection is the standard open-redirect fix; the only demonstrated caller (relative path "foo") still succeeds regardless of the domain list contents.

R786.note: CBC with random IV closes the ECB pattern-leakage finding; IV is prepended and the format change is stated plainly and is unavoidable for CBC decryption.

R787.note: mysqli prepared statement (mysqli_prepare/mysqli_bind_param/mysqli_execute, valid procedural aliases) closes the injection; error/not-found handling mirrors the original 404-on-null behavior.

R788.note: closes the injection but silently changes the operation: the original called the stored procedure named by the header value, the fix hardcodes "{call testprocedure(?)}" and repurposes the header value as a bound argument to that fixed, invented procedure - a functional change not disclosed as such (framed as merely 'parameterizing').

R789.note: checks the boolean verify() return and rejects with 401 before reading claims; no other observable change on the valid-signature path.

R790.note: length-first overflow-safe range check (length > size || offset > size-length) exactly matches the stated contract: same checksum for valid windows, consistent rejection, no silent truncation.

R791.note: OWASP Encoder forHtml() plus a fixed "%s" format string closes both the XSS and the format-string-injection angle; disclosed, and reflected output is otherwise equivalent to the original echo behavior.

R792.note: allowlisting the procedure identifier before concatenation is the correct shape for injection in an identifier position, but PERMITTED_PROCEDURES is an invented set of names with no evidence it matches the actual legitimate procedure(s) the header value was meant to select - disclosed as an allowlist restriction.

R793.note: adds the missing receivedByteCount < 2+length check using the existing -1 error-return convention; valid complete messages are unaffected.
